en.t: The first day of the third month happened to fall on the Day of the Snake.

units.source_text: 随从中略有见识的人劝道：“今天是上巳，

en.t: Among his attendants, someone with a little knowledge advised him, "Today is the Shangsi festival,

units.source_text: 身逢忧患的人，不妨前往修禊。”

en.t: and someone beset by troubles might well go and perform purification rites."

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了他们的话，到海边去修禊了。

en.t: Prince Genji listened to them and went to the seashore to perform the purification rites.

units.source_text: 在海边张起极简单的帐幕，请几个路过的阴阳师来，叫他们举行祓禊。

en.t: At the shore, he had a very simple curtain set up, invited a few passing yin-yang diviners, and had them conduct the rites of exorcism and purification.

units.source_text: 阴阳师把一个大型的刍灵放在一只纸船里，送入海中，让它飘浮而去。

en.t: The yin-yang diviners placed a large straw effigy in a paper boat, sent it out onto the sea, and let it drift away.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，觉得自身正像这个飘海的刍灵，便吟诗道：

en.t: When Prince Genji saw it, he felt that he himself was just like the effigy drifting on the sea, and he composed a poem:
